summary.headline: Astrological Questions and Inceptions
summary.text: Catalog of astrological questions and elections in a Florentine codex, covering illness, hermaphroditic sterility, buying, lost objects, judgments, runaways, thieves, inceptions, truth or falsehood, friendships and enmities, fetal sex, pregnancy, and travelers’ returns. It cites Codex Florentinus 12 and attributes a universal lunar selection of inceptions to Hermes Trismegistus, with Apomasar also quoted.
